Card Q&A.a: No battle occurs, and the attack ends. If there are other When Attacking effects, "when one of your Digimon attacks" effects, and/or effects activated at blocker timing, they activate, and then the attack ends.
Card Q&A.q: I use this Digimon to attack an opponent's Digimon, then use this Digimon's effect to reduce the opponent's Digimon to 0 DP. What happens to the attack?

Card Q&A.a: No, the effect has already activated, so the -2000 DP lasts until the end of the turn.
Card Q&A.q: After I use this Digimon's effect to give an opponent's Digimon -2000 DP, my memory drops to 2 or less. Does my opponent's Digimon revert to its original DP?

Effect: [When Attacking] If you have 3 or more memory, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
